blocks.text: Sealroll remembers the practical care of keeping a wrap closed until it is needed. Its small seal and wound strip carry that habit into Era Four without requiring a ceremonial title.
A sealed ribbon spindle. Break the seal and draw out its wrap.
One-shot use: The seal pops off and the broad wrap unrolls from the spindle into a long open ribbon. The game performs the final fade.
16 silver. Injury / Infection severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +7; Cleanliness +4. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
